task: Immutable SSTable (ae.sst): writer, validating reader, Bloom filter, k-way merge
reasoning_summary: Built the full image in memory so invalid input leaves no file, then wrote via temp file and atomic move. Keys compare as unsigned UTF-8 bytes consistently; the reader validates magic, offsets, CRC, every entry and index slot. Tests include every-byte-flip, valid-CRC crafted offsets and randomized merge against a TreeMap model.
